brief:
The Shehab Wire reported that Gaza has emerged as a significant factor reshaping U.S. political and electoral landscapes, transforming the conflict into a tool for public pressure and accountability against both Republican and Democratic parties. The shift reflects growing student and grassroots protests alongside expanding public rejection of American military support for Israeli occupation.

The war in Gaza has mobilized constituencies that were previously peripheral to U.S. campaign strategies, forcing both major parties to reckon with electoral consequences tied to their positions on the conflict and aid to Israel.

title: Gaza becomes decisive issue in American electoral politics
